_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::pasi#3, and a falsification of its Signal. Raising PASI DYNAMIC/TIMESTEP from 5e-4 to 5e-3 on upstream pasi_twoway_norelax_particle_dem_1d_normalcontact_linspring_walldiscretcond.4C.yaml, with the structural model and contact parameters untouched, does not show up as wobbling particles: 4C runs a partitioned two-way iteration inside each step, and once the particle response stops being a contraction the iteration fails with 'The partitioned PASI solver did not converge in ITEMAX steps!' from pasi/4C_pasi_partitioned_twowaycoup.cpp line 419. It aborts there, so no result test is reached and there is no trajectory to inspect, and the message names neither the particle field, nor the contact stiffness, nor the time step. No 'oscillat' string appears anywhere. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: The partitioned PASI solver did not converge in ITEMAX steps!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the coupled step at the deck's own value. The partitioned iteration converges again, the deck passes and EXIT_BIGDT becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
